newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SHOWCASE-ARSENAL V ASTON VILLA FACTS/FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHOWCASE-ARSENAL V ASTON VILLA FACTS/FIGURES.

text.p: Facts and figures for Saturday's English premier league match between Arsenal and Aston Villa:
Formed 1886 as Dial Square, known as Royal Arsenal 1886-91; Woolwich Arsenal 1891-1914. Arsenal since 1914.

Major honours: European Cup Winners Cup winners 1994; English league champions 1931, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1938, 1948, 1953, 1971, 1989, 1991; F.A. Cup winners 1930, 1936, 1950, 1971, 1979, 1993; League Cup winners 1987, 1993; Inter Cities Fairs Cup winners 1970. Double performed: 1971
Record League goalscorer: Cliff Bastin, 150, 1930-47 (total Arsenal goals 178)
Most capped player: Kenny Sansom, England, 77 caps

Major honours: European Champions Cup winners 1982; English league champions 1894, 1896, 1897, 1899, 1900, 1910, 1981; F.A. Cup winners 1887, 1895, 1897, 1905, 1913, 1920, 1957; League Cup winners: 1961, 1975, 1977, 1994, 1996. Double performed: 1897
Most capped player: Peter McParland, N.Ireland, 33 caps
Arsenal v Aston Villa league record:
Record victories: Aston Villa 1, Arsenal 7, Villa Park, 1935-36; Aston Villa 5, Arsenal 0, Villa Park, 1920-21
Corresponding match last season: Arsenal 2 (Merson 47, Wright 78), Aston Villa 0. Saturday, October 21, 1995. Attendance: 38,271

Fascinating fact: Arsenal's 7-1 victory at Villa Park on December 14, 1935 is one of the most famous English league matches of all time as all seven Arsenal goals were scored by Ted Drake -- the first time such a feat had been achieved in the English league since James Ross scored seven for Preston in 1888. Drake had eight shots in the match -- scored from seven, hit the bar with the other.
